BEFORE YOU ENQUIRE

Plan the pipework before decorating

A radiator relocation can involve access under floors or behind finishes. If you are redecorating or changing flooring, mention the sequence of work when enquiring. A new radiator needs to suit the room’s heating requirements as well as the wall space available.

  • Show the current radiator and proposed new position.
  • Include dimensions of the available wall space.
  • Mention other work happening in the room.
